statement: Price of inference at fixed capability falls >= 10x from 2026 to 2027 (Epoch / AI Index price series; 2027 annual)
status_at_phase_end: The 2026->2027 window had not started, but the 2025 base rate was well above 10x/yr. A compute tracker (Mar 2025) found the price to reach fixed benchmark scores fell 9-900x per year (median 50x; 200x using post-2024 data only). An annual AI report (Apr 2025) found GPT-3.5-level cost fell >280x in ~2 years. 2025 price moves were consistent with this: a Bloc A reasoning model cut 80% (Jun), a new Bloc A flagship launched at lower per-token prices (Aug), and a Bloc B developer cut API prices 50%+ (Sep). Key caveat: the fastest declines come from short windows and may not last.

items.summary: A compute tracker found that the price of reaching fixed performance on six benchmarks fell 9-900x per year (median 50x). Using only data from 2024 on, the median was 200x per year. Example: GPT-4-level PhD-science performance got ~40x cheaper per year. The fastest rates rest on <1 year of data.
items.detail: Epoch AI Data Insight 'LLM inference prices have fallen rapidly but unequally across tasks' (March 2025; X thread ~2025-03-13; date approximate).

items.summary: An annual AI report found that the inference cost of a system at GPT-3.5 level (64.8% MMLU) fell over 280-fold from Nov 2022 to Oct 2024, from ~$20 to ~$0.07 per million tokens, driven by capable small models.
items.detail: Stanford HAI, 2025 AI Index Report, Top Takeaway 7 (published ~2025-04-07).

items.summary: A Bloc A developer cut the API price of its flagship reasoning model by 80% (to ~$2/$8 per million input/output tokens), a step change at fixed capability.
items.detail: OpenAI o3 price reduction (2025-06-10). Recollection; not verified via web_extract this run.

items.summary: The same developer launched a new flagship (ECI ~150, the frontier at release) at ~$1.25/$10 per million tokens, below its earlier frontier model's launch price for higher capability.
items.detail: OpenAI GPT-5 launch pricing (2025-08-07). Price from recollection; ECI from Epoch table (GPT-5 medium = 150 anchor).

items.summary: A Bloc B developer released an experimental open-weight model with sparse attention at about the same benchmark performance as its predecessor, and cut API prices by 50%+ (input $0.56 -> $0.28 per M tokens; output to $0.42).
items.detail: DeepSeek, 'Introducing DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp' (2025-09-29); Reuters, TechCrunch, heise same day.

items.summary: No single official series pins 'price at fixed capability' for the indicator. Estimates depend heavily on the benchmark and threshold chosen (9x to 900x/yr), so a 10x bar can pass or fail depending on method. The indicator needs a frozen benchmark/threshold before 2026.
items.detail: Method note derived from Epoch (Mar 2025) range; AI Index uses MMLU 64.8% threshold.
